items.summary: 【Pakistan says Middle East oil shock accelerating EV transition】Pakistan expects to reach its previously announced EV penetration target sooner than 2030, a senior government adviser said, after a spike in fuel costs since the Middle East conflict cut electric vehicle payback periods to about 1–1.5 years. items.title: Kingfa Science & Technology raises prices on modified plastics 1,000–2,500 yuan/ton
items.summary: 【Kingfa Science & Technology raises prices on modified plastics 1,000–2,500 yuan/ton】Kingfa Science & Technology said in a customer notice it will raise prices on multiple modified-plastic grades, citing sustained Middle East tensions that have kept international oil prices elevated and pushed petrochemical feedstock, chemical-additive, energy and processing costs beyond the company’s ability to absorb. Price changes: modified PA6 up 2,500 yuan/ton; modified PP, modified PE, modified PA66, modified PBT up 2,000 yuan/ton; modified ABS, modified PS, modified PC up 1,500 yuan/ton; modified PVC up 1,000 yuan/ton. Adjustments apply to orders received from Oct 8, 2026.

康惠股份：不存在承接亿安天下的IDC业务
items.summary: 【康惠股份：不存在承接亿安天下的IDC业务】康惠股份在10月8日召开的2026年半年度业绩说明会上表示，截至目前，公司不存在承接亿安天下（及其关联方）的IDC业务，也不存在承接相关业务的计划或安排。公司与亿安天下在业务、资产、机构、人员、财务等方面保持独立。
